# TWINGS

> TWINGS is a service by YAGI WORKSHOP Inc. (야기워크숍 주식회사) for AI video and image templates featuring a user's own face and studio-managed brand creator campaigns.

Public template examples can be browsed without an account. Personal generation is in a limited rollout; a published example or listed price does not mean checkout is open to everyone. Do not describe planned subscription plans, social integrations, or native mobile apps as available features.

## Public pages

- [English overview](https://twings.app/en): What TWINGS offers.
- [한국어 소개](https://twings.app/ko): 서비스 소개.
- [Video templates](https://twings.app/en/video): Published video examples.
- [Image templates](https://twings.app/en/image): Published image examples.
- [Campaigns](https://twings.app/en/campaigns): Studio-managed brand campaigns and creator opportunities.
- [캠페인](https://twings.app/ko/campaigns): 브랜드 의뢰와 크리에이터 참여 안내.
- [Pricing](https://twings.app/en/pricing): Single-template prices and an upcoming monthly video plan; enrollment is not open.
- [요금 안내](https://twings.app/ko/pricing): 템플릿별 단건 가격과 준비 중인 월 구독 설계. 구독 신청은 아직 받지 않습니다.
- [FAQ](https://twings.app/en/faq): Usage, payment, photos and likeness rights, creator participation, brand enquiries.
- [자주 묻는 질문](https://twings.app/ko/faq): 이용·결제·사진과 초상권·캠페인·브랜드 의뢰.
